page: Microsoft Azure E64s_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ESv5 server family. It is built on the x86_64 architecture and powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor running at 2.8 GHz. The configuration includes 64 dedicated virtual CPUs, which correspond to 32 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The system is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, yielding a high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. This instance does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, relying entirely on external Premium Storage for disk operations.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance and memory throughput. The server achieved a strong rating in multi-core stress-ng CPU tests and multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, alongside high large-block memory read and write bandwidths. Single-core performance, such as stress-ng single-core and Geekbench single-core, falls within the average range. Cryptographic and vector processing capabilities are supported by hardware-level AVX-512 and AES instruction sets.

While the instance excels in memory-intensive operations, it exhibits clear tradeoffs in specialized workloads. Large language model text generation with a 70B model is weak, delivering only 2.73 tokens per second due to the lack of dedicated GPU acceleration. However, its high memory density and strong database operations score make it highly efficient for relational databases, enterprise applications, and memory-cached web serving.
description: Microsoft Azure E64s_v5 is a memory-optimized virtual machine from the ESv5 family, featuring 64 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor at 2.8 GHz. It is equipped with 512.0 GB of RAM, providing an 8:1 RAM-to-vCPU ratio, but lacks local storage and GPU accelerators. Benchmark results show strong multi-core CPU performance, high large-block memory bandwidth, and excellent database operation capabilities. Conversely, single-core processing and large-scale LLM inference speeds are average to weak, reflecting the lack of hardware acceleration. This server is optimized for memory-intensive enterprise workloads, relational databases, and multi-threaded compilation tasks where high memory density is required.
